row:
Welcome to Little Steps Pediatric Rehab! 🌈

 I'm, a Pediatric Physical Therapist. This channel provides evidence-based information on pediatric physical therapy, child development, developmental milestones, early intervention, and pediatric rehabilitation. 
Learn about Cerebral Palsy (CP), Autism (ASD), Down Syndrome, developmental delay, torticollis, toe walking, hypotonia, gross motor skills, balance, coordination, and home exercise programs. 

Whether you're a parent, caregiver, student, or healthcare professional, you'll find educational videos, and expert guidance to support every child's development. 

📩 Online Consultations Available
📱 Instagram: @littlestepsrehab_ 
👥 Facebook: Little Steps Pediatric Rehab

Subscribe, Like & Comment  join us as we support every child's journey—one little step at a time🩷
